# Alexander Kolisch

> Director E-Commerce und Marketing. Digital Transformation. Omnichannel. E-Commerce. Marketing. CRM. Loyalty.

## Identity

- Full name: Alexander Kolisch
- Current role: Co-Founder & Managing Partner at Webmatch Advise GmbH (since 09/2026); additionally Director E-Commerce und Marketing at Polo Motorrad und Sportswear GmbH (since 08/2024)
- Location: Düsseldorf, Germany
- Website: https://alexanderkolisch.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexanderkolisch/

## Professional Summary

Alexander Kolisch is a digital executive with more than 20 years of experience in e-commerce, omnichannel retail, marketing, and digital transformation. He has held leadership positions as Chief Digital Officer, Director E-Commerce & Marketing, and Head of Digital in mid-sized companies and international corporations. His work spans retailers, manufacturers, and industrial companies with direct reporting lines to CEOs, boards, and shareholders. He has P&L responsibility, team leadership, and a track record of measurable results.

He also brings entrepreneurial experience as a VC-backed founder with a successful exit, and experience on the investor side at one of Europe's leading early-stage venture funds.

## Career Stations

- 09/2026–present: Co-Founder & Managing Partner, Webmatch Advise GmbH (https://advise.webmatch.de), Cologne/Düsseldorf. Strategic advisory at C-level for e-commerce, digital transformation, and marketing strategy. Joint venture with Webmatch GmbH.
- 08/2024–present: Director E-Commerce und Marketing, Polo Motorrad und Sportswear GmbH (https://www.polo-motorrad.com), Jüchen/Düsseldorf
- 01/2021–07/2024: Director E-Commerce, Marketing and Digital, SEVERIN Elektrogeräte GmbH (https://www.severin.de), Sundern
- 08/2017–12/2020: Chief Digital Officer, Positec Group / WORX (https://www.worx.com), Cologne/Suzhou
- 04/2015–07/2017: Head of Digital, Thalia Bücher GmbH (https://www.thalia.de), Berlin/Münster
- 01/2014–12/2016: Founder and Managing Director, Sporttsclub/fitback (Allianz Digital Accelerator)
- 07/2012–01/2014: Director Corporate Development, Bertelsmann SE (https://www.bertelsmann.com), Gütersloh/Berlin
- 11/2008–01/2011: Founder, Managing Director and Shareholder, steereo (Holtzbrinck Ventures investment, trade sale 2011)
- 04/2008–11/2008: Investment Manager, Holtzbrinck Ventures / HV Capital (https://www.hvcapital.com), Munich
- 12/2007–04/2008: Manager Digital Experience, EMI Music Germany, Cologne
- 02/2006–12/2007: Manager Broadband Video, ProSiebenSat.1 Media Group (https://www.prosiebensat1.com), Munich (launch of maxdome)

## Education

- MBA, ESADE Business School, Barcelona, Spain (Class of 2013). Ranked 7th globally in the Financial Times MBA Ranking. Triple-crown accredited (AACSB, EQUIS, AMBA).
- Diplom-Wirtschaftsingenieur (equivalent to M.Sc. in Business Engineering), Hochschule der Medien (HdM), Stuttgart, Germany (2006). Final grade 1.8.

## Key Competencies
